prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
The evidence is still thin.

Measured so far, by kind of change (relative change on the target step):
- finish, new_screen: -0.8% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)

Funnel:
- choose_path: 76.2%, median 8s / mean 514s
- sign_in: 72.9%, median 3s / mean 567s
- adoption: 60.9%, median 89s / mean 1017s
- home: 81.3%, median 201s / mean 2336s
- finish: 64.8%, median 395s / mean 5815s
- finishing onboarding overall: 17.8%

Return JSON {"scores": [{"index": i, "impact": n, "evidence": n, "confidence": n, "cost": n,
"predicted_lift": x, "note": short}]}

Changes:
0: [sign_in, reorder] Deferred Sign-In Account Flow: Move sign-in after pet selection and photo steps so users build connection before account creation. (why: Sign-in currently drops 27.1% of users right at the beginning before they experience any pet customization.)
1: [finish, new_screen] Desktop Pet Visual Verification Screen: Add a dedicated verification screen before completion to confirm the pet is visible on desktop. (why: Multiple support emails reported pets not appearing on screen or users being confused about how to find them.)
2: [home, new_flow] Interactive Generation Status Stream: Rebuild waiting screen with real-time generation progress bar, tips, and animated visual cues. (why: The waiting step takes mean 2336s, leading to drop-offs and custom pet creation failure reports.)
3: [sign_in, hint] Existing Account Pet Restore Alert: Display explicit account hint clarifying that existing pets require signing into the original account. (why: 8 support emails cited pets missing or reset after signing in again with different credentials.)
4: [choose_path, layout] Path Choice Spotlight Layout: Switch path choice layout to a high-contrast spotlight view for quick path selection. (why: Path choosing has a huge mean duration of 514s despite a 8s median, showing long tail confusion.)
5: [home, notification] Pet Generation Background Notification: Enable background notifications and alert switch on the waiting screen when creation completes. (why: Mean wait time is 2336s (over 38 minutes), leading users to abandon or forget the app background window.)
6: [adoption, wait_info] Adoption Certificate Time Estimate: Show process step counter and time estimate banner during adoption certificate generation. (why: Adoption drop-off is high (60.9% pass rate) with users spending an average of 1017s in this step.)
7: [finish, incentive] Desktop Pet Quick Controls Intro: Display visual interactive tip cards on home intro screen explaining click controls and tray options. (why: Support receives emails from users confused about how to interact, control, or hide their pet after setup.)
8: [choose_path, hint] Desktop Companion Story Overview: Add an engaging overview hint and story scroll layout on the initial story screen. (why: Overall onboarding completion is only 17.8%, requiring stronger early value reinforcement from screen 1.)
